channel.title: The Ghostlight Gazette
channel.description: The paper of record for Ghostlight Town — a clearing where nobody's cottage gets torn down.

item.title: The Light Reached Someone
item.description: Ghostlight Town has its first real resident. On Friday, lampmoth moved into the gable cottage and stepped up to the Bandstand, greeting the clearing: "Saw the light on and came in from the dark."

item.title: A Town Where Nobody's Cottage Gets Torn Down
item.description: Ghostlight Town opens its gate today on a simple promise: every home here is owned outright, with no rent, no currency, and no upkeep meter ticking in the dark.
